candidates.asymmetry: A stripped, optimised, LTO-linked binary does not declare which primitives it contains; the build knows exactly.
candidates.buyer: Every large enterprise and government agency under CNSA 2.0 and EO 14412 timelines. Genuinely enormous and genuinely mandated.
candidates.manufacture_mechanism: Compile binaries against known crypto libraries with known primitives and parameters; the label is the configuration used. Free and exact at unlimited scale.
candidates.market_event: NIST finalised FIPS 203/204/205, the first post-quantum standards, creating a mandated inventory-and-migrate obligation. Reinforced by Executive Order 14412 'Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks' directing CISA and NIST to publish minimum CBOM elements within 270 days.
candidates.name: Cryptographic inventory / CBOM from binaries (post-quantum migration)
post_event_efforts: CREBench: Evaluating Large Language Models in Cryptographic Binary Reverse Engineering (arXiv 2604.03750, 2026) - a benchmark for the exact task
Identification of Cryptographic Algorithms Based on CNN (ACM conference proceedings, 2025)
USPTO 12229279 and USPTO 12153686, both 'Cryptography bill of materials (CBOM) generation from binary executables' - patents on precisely the proposed task

Commercial, funded and shipping: IBM Quantum Safe Explorer; SandboxAQ AQtive Guard, positioned explicitly as large-scale AI-powered discovery; Keyfactor Command Risk Intelligence, which acquired InfoSec Global in 2025 for CBOM-grade cryptographic inventory
prior_efforts: Automated Identification of Cryptographic Primitives in Binary Programs (2012)
A Neural Network-Based Approach for Cryptographic Function Detection in Malware (2020)
FoC: Figure out the Cryptographic Functions in Stripped Binaries with LLMs (arXiv 2403.18403, March 2024 - five months BEFORE the market event, so non-disqualifying by the frozen rule)
candidates.verdict_note: FAILS on post-event efforts, decisively. Two patents, a benchmark, a conference paper and three funded commercial products all postdate the market event by less than 24 months.

candidates.buyer: Banks, call centres, fraud vendors. Large and growing fast.
candidates.manufacture_mechanism: Synthesise speech with known TTS systems; the label is the system used.
candidates.market_event: Voice-deepfake fraud becoming a named, funded enterprise threat category
candidates.market_event_date: UNDATED - could not tie to a specific citable event
candidates.name: Synthetic speech source tracing (which TTS system generated this audio)
post_event_efforts: MLAAD: 82 synthesis systems across 38 languages and 38 architectures
DiffSSD: ~200 hours, 70,000 synthetic and 24,226 real samples, 10 TTS systems
Interspeech 2025 dedicated special session on source tracing
Multiple 2026 papers on open-set source tracing and attribution
prior_efforts: Transformer-Based Speech Synthesizer Attribution in an Open Set Scenario (2022)
candidates.verdict_note: FAILS on both clauses. Open datasets exist at scale AND the field is dense.

candidates.asymmetry: Decoded pixels do not declare the encoder settings.
candidates.buyer: Streaming platforms, ad verification, content provenance. Large.
candidates.manufacture_mechanism: Encode any video under known encoder/preset/CRF; the label is free and exact.
candidates.market_event: UNDATED - streaming and ad-verification demand is continuous, not event-driven
candidates.name: Video encoder and settings recovery from decoded video
post_event_efforts: Multi-stage neural network reporting 98.88% accuracy for CRF prediction
Automatic Generation of H.264 Parameter Sets to Recover Video File Fragments (arXiv 2104.14522) - the carved-fragment version of the task, for video
prior_efforts: Video double-compression and codec forensics literature
candidates.verdict_note: FAILS. Also fails G6: 5 MB per unit x 1e6 is 5e12 bytes against a 2e10 budget.

candidates.asymmetry: Published weights do not declare their ancestry, and the fine-tuner may actively hide it.
candidates.buyer: Model owners enforcing licences, regulators, platforms. Large and new.
candidates.manufacture_mechanism: Fine-tune known base models; the label is the base you started from.

candidates.name: LLM model provenance (which base model is this fine-tune derived from)

Model Genome: Fingerprinting Whether an LLM Was Trained From Scratch or Derived
